input_quantization.method: Each full-prompt layer/chunk invocation has at most chunk_tokens distinct input rows. Account for repeated requests via the GLU-decision call count. Routed MMQ input rows above this bound prove repeated quantization. Exact per-call/per-token distinct counts were not captured.

scope: Working-fork host dispatch capture, 600/8192 prompts, two requests each, 16 outputs. Phase 0 setup/calibration; phase 1 prefill; phase 2 decode. T2-8 here are expert prefill batches, not an enabled speculative verifier. No timings/DRAM bandwidth inferred from counters.
